name: Volksoper
notes: Server-rendered month pages at /spielplan/<german-month>-<year>.de.html; iterates from current month to EA_HORIZON_DAYS out. Months with no shows (e.g. August, house dark) silently serve the next month's content instead of an empty page, so records are deduped by (source_id, start) across months. No real category field on the listing (only CSS state classes like event-premiere/weekend), so category is left null rather than guessed from the description blurb. Price is a tier label ("Preise A".."Preise Z"), not a number, so price_min is always null and price_text carries the label. district hardcoded to 1090 (Volksoper's own address; all listed venues are in-house: Volksoper, Balkon-Foyer).
